questions.question: Who was the first Prime Minister of India?
questions.explanation: Jawaharlal Nehru served as the first PM of India from 1947 to 1964.

questions.question: Which Article of the Indian Constitution abolishes untouchability?
questions.explanation: Article 17 abolishes 'Untouchability' and forbids its practice in any form.

questions.question: Which is the longest river in India?
questions.explanation: Ganga (approx. 2525 km) is the longest river in India.

questions.question: The chemical formula of water is:
questions.explanation: Water = H₂O (2 hydrogen atoms + 1 oxygen atom).

questions.question: RBI was established in which year?
questions.explanation: Reserve Bank of India was established on 1 April 1935.

questions.question: The Battle of Plassey was fought in:
questions.explanation: Battle of Plassey (1757) — Robert Clive defeated Siraj ud-Daulah, establishing British rule in Bengal.

questions.question: Which schedule of the Indian Constitution lists the official languages?
questions.explanation: The 8th Schedule lists 22 official languages of India.

questions.question: How many bones are in the adult human body?
questions.explanation: An adult human body has 206 bones.

questions.question: Which is the highest peak in India?
questions.explanation: Kanchenjunga (8,586m) is the highest peak entirely within India.

questions.question: Newton's first law of motion is also known as:
questions.explanation: Newton's 1st Law = Law of Inertia: body continues in its state unless acted upon by a force.

questions.question: National Animal of India is:
questions.explanation: Bengal Tiger is the National Animal of India (since 1973).

questions.question: GST in India was implemented on:
questions.explanation: Goods and Services Tax (GST) was implemented on 1 July 2017.

questions.question: The Jallianwala Bagh massacre occurred on:
questions.explanation: The Jallianwala Bagh massacre took place on 13 April 1919 in Amritsar.

questions.question: Which vitamin is produced when skin is exposed to sunlight?
questions.explanation: Sunlight triggers Vitamin D synthesis in the skin.

questions.question: Which ocean is the largest?
questions.explanation: Pacific Ocean is the largest and deepest ocean on Earth.

questions.question: The Preamble of the Indian Constitution begins with:
questions.explanation: The Preamble opens with 'WE, THE PEOPLE OF INDIA'.

questions.question: The SI unit of electric current is:
questions.explanation: Ampere (A) is the SI unit of electric current.

questions.question: National Flower of India:
questions.explanation: Lotus (Nelumbo nucifera) is the National Flower of India.

questions.question: Which institution regulates the capital market in India?
questions.explanation: SEBI (Securities and Exchange Board of India) regulates the capital market.

questions.question: Who wrote the book 'Discovery of India'?
questions.explanation: 'The Discovery of India' was written by Jawaharlal Nehru in 1946 while in Ahmednagar jail.

questions.question: The Tropic of Cancer passes through how many Indian states?
questions.explanation: Tropic of Cancer passes through 8 states: Gujarat, Rajasthan, MP, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, West Bengal, Tripura, Mizoram.

questions.question: Which is the largest organ in the human body?
questions.explanation: Skin is the largest organ of the human body.

questions.question: pH of pure water is:
questions.explanation: Pure water has a neutral pH of 7.

questions.question: 'Satyameva Jayate' is taken from which scripture?
questions.explanation: 'Satyameva Jayate' (Truth alone triumphs) is from the Mundaka Upanishad.

questions.question: Which Five Year Plan in India adopted the 'Socialistic Pattern of Society'?
questions.explanation: The Second Five Year Plan (1956–61) adopted the objective of a Socialistic Pattern of Society.
